groups.title: Reverse Linked List
groups.notes: Reverse a singly linked list and return its new head. The cached objective is complete; the dangling example heading adds no evidence and is excluded from automatic grouping.

groups.title: Valid Parentheses
groups.notes: Determine whether (), [] and {} brackets are balanced and correctly nested. Both return a boolean verdict.

groups.title: Maximum Subarray
groups.notes: Return the maximum sum of a nonempty contiguous subarray, including all-negative inputs. Kadane's Algorithm is the GFG title alias.

groups.title: Linked List Cycle
groups.notes: Determine whether a singly linked list contains a cycle. Position indexing is judge setup rather than the function input; both support Floyd cycle detection.

groups.title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock
groups.notes: Return maximum profit with at most one purchase followed by one sale, or zero if no profitable transaction exists. Unlimited-transaction variants remain separate.

groups.title: Add Two Numbers
groups.notes: Add reverse-order nonnegative digit lists and return the sum list.

groups.title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
groups.notes: Return the length of the longest contiguous substring with no repeated characters; output format explicitly confirms length.

groups.title: Median of Two Sorted Arrays
groups.notes: Median of the union of two sorted arrays; binary partition meets both logarithmic requirements.

groups.title: Palindrome Number
groups.notes: Boolean decimal palindrome predicate on an integer; negative inputs do not read the same in reverse.

groups.title: Regular Expression Matching
groups.notes: Whole-string regular-expression matching: dot matches one character and star repeats the preceding element zero or more times.

groups.title: Container With Most Water
groups.notes: Maximize water area between two vertical lines; width is the index gap and height is the lower endpoint.

groups.title: Roman to Integer
groups.notes: Convert a valid Roman numeral using the same seven symbols and subtractive convention.

groups.title: Letter Combinations of a Phone Number
groups.notes: Enumerate all telephone-keypad letter combinations for digits 2 through 9, in arbitrary order.

groups.title: 4Sum
groups.notes: Return unique quadruplets of distinct indices whose values sum to the given target; judge printing the count does not change the returned list.

groups.title: Generate Parentheses
groups.notes: Enumerate all well-formed parentheses strings. Preserve whether the input counts pairs or total characters.

geeksforgeeks:702078.notes: Input n is an even total output length; use n/2 pairs.

groups.title: Remove Duplicates from Sorted Array
groups.notes: Deduplicate a sorted array in place with constant extra memory and return its new prefix length.

groups.title: Next Permutation
groups.notes: Mutate a permutation to its next lexicographic arrangement, wrapping to ascending order when no successor exists.

groups.title: Longest Valid Parentheses
groups.notes: Return the length of the longest well-formed parentheses substring.

groups.title: Search in Rotated Sorted Array
groups.notes: Return zero-based target index or -1 in a rotated sorted array of distinct integers in logarithmic time. Repeated test queries are judge wrappers.

groups.title: Find First and Last Position of Element in Sorted Array
groups.notes: Return first and last zero-based target positions in a sorted array, or [-1,-1]; logarithmic bounds.

groups.title: Search Insert Position
groups.notes: Lower-bound index for a target in a sorted distinct array; returns insertion position when absent.

groups.title: Valid Sudoku
groups.notes: Check only consistency of already-filled Sudoku cells, without solving the puzzle. Zero versus dot is an empty-cell encoding.

groups.title: Sudoku Solver
groups.notes: Fill a 9x9 Sudoku puzzle under row, column and subgrid uniqueness; zero versus dot is an input representation.

groups.title: First Missing Positive
groups.notes: Smallest missing positive integer in an unsorted possibly negative array, in linear time and constant auxiliary space.

groups.title: Trapping Rain Water
groups.notes: Total trapped rainwater for unit-width elevation bars, not maximum container area.

groups.title: Permutations
groups.notes: Enumerate all permutations of an array of distinct integers in arbitrary order.

groups.title: Group Anagrams
groups.notes: Partition input strings into anagram groups; group and member order do not matter.

groups.title: Spiral Matrix
groups.notes: Return the spiral traversal of a rectangular matrix; identical traversal objective under different judge wrappers.

groups.title: Jump Game
groups.notes: Boolean reachability of the final index when each value is the maximum forward jump; minimum-jump versions remain separate.

groups.title: Insert Interval
groups.notes: Insert one interval into sorted non-overlapping intervals, merge intersections, and return a sorted non-overlapping result.

groups.title: Length of Last Word
groups.notes: Length of the final non-space word, ignoring trailing spaces.

groups.title: Unique Paths
groups.notes: Count paths in an obstacle-free rectangular grid from top-left to bottom-right with only right/down moves; same exact count.

groups.title: Minimum Path Sum
groups.notes: Minimum sum from top-left to bottom-right in a nonnegative grid with only down/right steps.

groups.title: Edit Distance
groups.notes: Unit-cost Levenshtein distance with insertion, deletion and replacement; no transposition operation.

groups.title: Search a 2D Matrix
groups.notes: Boolean target membership in a row-major globally sorted matrix; Yes/No is judge output serialization.

groups.title: Minimum Window Substring
groups.notes: Shortest source substring containing every target character with multiplicity. The Code360 domain guarantees a unique existing answer; the general algorithm handles that domain.

groups.title: Combinations
groups.notes: Enumerate all k-element combinations of labels 1 through n.

groups.title: Subsets
groups.notes: Enumerate the power set of distinct input integers; positive-only input is a domain restriction.

groups.title: Word Search
groups.notes: Boolean orthogonal-grid word search without reusing a cell.

groups.title: Search in Rotated Sorted Array II
groups.notes: Boolean target membership in a rotated sorted array that may contain duplicate values.

groups.title: Partition List
groups.notes: Stable linked-list partition into values below threshold followed by values at least threshold.

groups.title: Scramble String
groups.notes: Boolean recursive scramble equivalence via nonempty splits and optional swaps of the two pieces.

groups.title: Symmetric Tree
groups.notes: Boolean mirror symmetry of a binary tree around its root.

groups.title: Maximum Depth of Binary Tree
groups.notes: Maximum root-to-leaf depth measured in nodes, not edges.

groups.title: Construct Binary Tree from Inorder and Postorder Traversal
groups.notes: Reconstruct a unique-valued binary tree from its inorder and postorder traversals.

groups.title: Minimum Depth of Binary Tree
groups.notes: Minimum root-to-leaf depth measured in nodes; a single-child node is not a leaf.

groups.title: Flatten Binary Tree to Linked List
groups.notes: Flatten the existing binary tree in preorder using right pointers as next links and null left pointers.

groups.title: Distinct Subsequences
groups.notes: Count occurrences of a target string as subsequences of a source string; not the count of all distinct source subsequences.

groups.title: Populating Next Right Pointers in Each Node II
groups.notes: Populate immediate right-neighbor pointers at every level of an arbitrary binary tree, with null at each level end.

groups.title: Pascal's Triangle
groups.notes: Return the first n rows of Pascal triangle, not only its nth row.

groups.title: Triangle
groups.notes: Minimum top-to-bottom triangular path sum, moving to either of the two adjacent entries in the next row.

groups.title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock II
groups.notes: Maximum stock profit with unlimited transactions but at most one share held; no fee or cooldown.

groups.title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock III
groups.notes: Maximum stock profit with at most two non-overlapping transactions.

groups.title: Binary Tree Maximum Path Sum
groups.notes: Maximum sum of a nonempty simple path anywhere in a binary tree, including negative node values.

groups.title: Longest Consecutive Sequence
groups.notes: Length of the longest consecutive-value run in an unsorted array, ignoring duplicates; expected linear time.

groups.title: Palindrome Partitioning
groups.notes: Enumerate all partitions of a string into palindromic substrings.

groups.title: Reverse Words in a String
groups.notes: Reverse word order, collapse separating whitespace, and remove leading/trailing whitespace.

groups.title: Maximum Product Subarray
groups.notes: Maximum product of a nonempty contiguous subarray, allowing negative entries and zeros.

groups.title: Find Minimum in Rotated Sorted Array
groups.notes: Minimum value of a rotated ascending array with distinct elements, in logarithmic time.

groups.title: Intersection of Two Linked Lists
groups.notes: Return the first shared node by pointer identity in two singly linked lists, or null; value-set intersection remains separate.

groups.title: Find Peak Element
groups.notes: Return an index of any strict peak with negative-infinity virtual endpoints and unequal adjacent elements.

groups.title: Maximum Gap
groups.notes: Maximum adjacent gap after sorting values; return zero for fewer than two elements, with a linear-time bucket/radix solution.

groups.title: Majority Element
groups.notes: Return the value occurring strictly more than n/2 times. Some versions guarantee existence, others require a no-majority sentinel.

groups.title: Unique Binary Search Trees
groups.notes: Count structurally unique BSTs on the ordered labels 1..n.

groups.title: Clone Graph
groups.notes: Deep-copy the connected undirected graph, preserving labels and neighbor relationships with new nodes.

groups.title: Single Number
groups.notes: Find the sole value appearing once while every other value appears twice; XOR meets linear time and constant space.

groups.title: Copy List with Random Pointer
groups.notes: Deep-copy both next and random links of a linked list; copied pointers must reference copied nodes.

groups.title: Word Break
groups.notes: Boolean segmentation of a string into reusable dictionary words.

groups.title: Word Break II
groups.notes: Enumerate all dictionary-word segmentations as sentences, with words reusable.

groups.title: Linked List Cycle II
groups.notes: Return the entry node of a linked-list cycle, or null when absent; preserve the list.

groups.title: Reorder List
groups.notes: Reorder existing linked-list nodes by alternating first and last, then second and second-last.

groups.title: LRU Cache
groups.notes: LRU key/value cache with get=-1 for misses, updates on put, and least-recently-used eviction; hash map plus list meets all bounds.

groups.title: Repeated DNA Sequences
groups.notes: Return all length-10 DNA substrings occurring more than once. Upper/lower-case alphabet serialization is a representation difference.

groups.title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock IV
groups.notes: Maximum stock profit with at most k completed non-overlapping buy/sell transactions.

groups.title: Delete Duplicate Emails
groups.notes: Delete duplicate-email rows, retaining the smallest id for each email.

groups.title: Rising Temperature
groups.notes: Return weather row IDs with temperature greater than the preceding calendar day.

groups.title: House Robber
groups.notes: Maximum sum of non-adjacent house values in a line; not the circular variant or the equal-value n,k special case.

groups.title: Isomorphic Strings
groups.notes: Boolean bijective character substitution preserving all positions and equal-character occurrences.

groups.title: Course Schedule
groups.notes: Boolean feasibility of completing every course under prerequisite edges; course labels are identifiers, and a cycle makes it impossible.

groups.title: Course Schedule II
groups.notes: Return any topological course ordering, or an empty list if prerequisite constraints are cyclic.

groups.title: Design Add and Search Words Data Structure
groups.notes: Word dictionary with insertion and whole-word lookup where dot matches any one character.

groups.title: Word Search II
groups.notes: Return dictionary words occurring in an orthogonally adjacent character grid, with no cell reused within one word.

groups.title: House Robber II
groups.notes: Maximum sum of robbed house values on a cycle with adjacent houses forbidden, including the first/last adjacency.

groups.title: Single Number III
groups.notes: Return the two once-occurring values when every other integer occurs twice, in linear time and constant space.

groups.title: Ugly Number II
groups.notes: Return the nth positive integer with no prime factors outside 2,3,5.

groups.title: First Bad Version
groups.notes: Find the first bad version in a monotone good/bad sequence with logarithmically many predicate calls.

groups.title: Expression Add Operators
groups.notes: Enumerate expressions formed by inserting +,-,* into a digit string to reach the target; normal multiplication precedence and no leading-zero operands.

groups.title: Peeking Iterator
groups.notes: Iterator adapter where peek returns the next value without advancing, alongside next and hasNext.

groups.title: Game of Life
groups.notes: Compute one simultaneous generation of the eight-neighbor Conway automaton, with birth at three and survival at two or three.

groups.title: Word Pattern
groups.notes: Boolean bijection between pattern characters and whitespace-delimited words.

groups.title: Serialize and Deserialize Binary Tree
groups.notes: Serialize and deserialize a binary tree with identical round-trip structure and node values; serialized storage type is a platform interface.

groups.title: Longest Increasing Subsequence
groups.notes: Return the length of a strictly increasing subsequence; not non-decreasing, contiguous, or count of subsequences.

groups.title: Reverse Substrings Between Each Pair of Parentheses
groups.notes: Reverse text inside matching parentheses from innermost out and remove all parentheses.

groups.title: Factorial Trailing Zeroes
groups.notes: Number of trailing zeros in n factorial.

groups.title: Longest String Chain
groups.notes: Longest word-chain length where each step inserts exactly one character without changing existing character order.

groups.title: Last Moment Before All Ants Fall Out of a Plank
groups.notes: Time of the last ant falling off a plank with unit speed and instantaneous direction swaps on collision.

groups.title: Split Array into Fibonacci Sequence
groups.notes: Split a digit string into at least three 32-bit nonnegative Fibonacci terms, with no leading zero except zero itself; any valid split or empty.

groups.title: Make Sum Divisible by P
groups.notes: Shortest removable contiguous subarray making the remaining positive-array sum divisible by p; cannot remove the whole array, -1 if impossible.

groups.title: Reformat Department Table
groups.notes: Pivot monthly department revenue into one row per department with a column for each named month.

groups.title: Number of Good Leaf Nodes Pairs
groups.notes: Count distinct leaf pairs whose tree distance in edges is at most the supplied threshold.

groups.title: Monotone Increasing Digits
groups.notes: Largest number at most n with non-decreasing decimal digits.

groups.title: Binary Tree Cameras
groups.notes: Minimum cameras on tree nodes, each covering its parent, itself and immediate children.

groups.title: Palindrome Linked List
groups.notes: Boolean palindrome predicate on singly linked-list values.

groups.title: Count the Number of Good Subarrays
groups.notes: Count contiguous subarrays with at least k equal-value index pairs; not a same-title task with another good-subarray definition.

groups.title: Diameter of Binary Tree
groups.notes: Binary-tree diameter as the maximum simple-path edge count, not node count.

groups.title: The Latest Login in 2020
groups.notes: Latest login per user within calendar year 2020, excluding users without a login that year.

groups.title: Not Boring Movies
groups.notes: Select odd-ID movies whose description is not boring, sorted by rating descending.

groups.title: Count Salary Categories
groups.notes: Count accounts in salary ranges below 20000, inclusive 20000..50000, above 50000; include zero-count categories.

groups.title: Fix Names in a Table
groups.notes: Capitalize the first character of each user name and lowercase the rest, ordering results by user_id.

groups.title: Maximum Sum Circular Subarray
groups.notes: Maximum sum of a nonempty circular-array subarray using each position at most once.

groups.title: Sliding Puzzle
groups.notes: Minimum orthogonal blank swaps to solve the fixed 2x3 sliding puzzle, -1 when unreachable.

groups.title: Customer Placing the Largest Number of Orders
groups.notes: Customer number with the greatest number of orders, with a unique winner guaranteed.

groups.title: Most Stones Removed with Same Row or Column
groups.notes: Maximum removable stones where each removed stone shares a row or column with a remaining stone.

groups.title: Reformat Date
groups.notes: Convert a valid ordinal-day and English month-name date to zero-padded YYYY-MM-DD.

groups.title: Increasing Order Search Tree
groups.notes: Rearrange BST nodes into the ascending inorder right-only chain with all left links null.

groups.title: Non-decreasing Array
groups.notes: Boolean feasibility of making an array non-decreasing by modifying at most one value.

groups.title: Longest Palindromic Subsequence
groups.notes: Length of the longest palindromic subsequence, not a contiguous substring.

groups.title: Min Cost Climbing Stairs
groups.notes: Minimum stair-climbing cost with one/two-step moves and either index zero or one as a starting step.

groups.title: Longest Palindromic Substring
groups.notes: Core task: return a longest palindromic substring. Tie-breaking is an explicit version contract, not a separate canonical task.

code360:8523.notes: Return the maximum-length palindrome with the smaller start index.

groups.title: Reverse Integer
groups.notes: Reverse a signed 32-bit integer using 32-bit arithmetic; overflow sentinels belong to individual versions.

leetcode:7.notes: Return 0 when reversal overflows signed 32-bit range.

code360:10753.notes: Return -1 when reversal overflows signed 32-bit range.

groups.title: Two Sum II - Input Array Is Sorted
groups.notes: Return two distinct indices in a sorted array whose values sum to target. Index base and uniqueness guarantees are version details.

leetcode:167.notes: Return indices in [1,n]; a unique solution is guaranteed.

code360:18796.notes: Return indices in [0,n-1]; any valid pair is accepted.

groups.title: Min Stack
groups.notes: Minimum-tracking stack with constant-time push/pop/top/min. Preserve operation return types and empty-stack behavior.

code360:17280.notes: Pop returns the removed value; pop/top/getMin return -1 on an empty stack. LeetCode pop returns void and query validity is guaranteed.

groups.title: Subsets II
groups.notes: Enumerate all distinct subsets of a multiset. Required result ordering is a platform-specific output contract.

code360:16763.notes: Return the subsets in the sorted format required by the judge.

groups.title: Restore IP Addresses
groups.notes: Enumerate IPv4 addresses formed by inserting three separators without removing/reordering digits, with valid octets and no leading zeros.

groups.title: Merge Intervals
groups.notes: Merge all intersecting closed intervals and return their union intervals.

code360:7572.notes: Return merged intervals by increasing start time.

groups.title: Combination Sum
groups.notes: Enumerate distinct target-sum combinations of positive candidates, with unlimited reuse.

code360:9265.notes: Elements within each returned combination must be non-decreasing.

groups.title: Combination Sum II
groups.notes: Enumerate unique target-sum combinations, using each input element at most once.

code360:9961.notes: Sort each combination and return the list in lexicographical order.

groups.title: Multiply Strings
groups.notes: Multiply two nonnegative decimal strings without a BigInteger library or whole-input integer conversion.

groups.title: Merge k Sorted Lists
groups.notes: Merge k increasing singly linked lists and return the merged sorted head.

groups.title: Swap Nodes in Pairs
groups.notes: Swap adjacent linked-list nodes pairwise and return the head.

groups.title: Largest Rectangle in Histogram
groups.notes: Largest rectangle area in a histogram of unit-width bars; linear-time stack meets both bounds.
